title: Course Schedule Order
statement: There are n courses numbered 1 to n and m rules 'a before b'. Print an order to take all courses that respects every rule. If several orders exist, print the smallest one in dictionary order.
input_format: The first line contains n and m. Each of the next m lines has a and b.
output_format: Print n course numbers separated by spaces, or IMPOSSIBLE if no valid order exists.

examples.explanation: Only course 1 can be taken first. Then 3 and 4 are available and 3 is smaller. After 3, course 2 becomes available and is smaller than 4, giving 1 3 2 4.

hints: A course can be taken once every course that must come before it is done.
Track how many unmet prerequisites each course has.
Use a min-heap of available courses to get the smallest order; if some course is never available, a cycle exists.
